senses.gloss: something that you do often and regularly, sometimes without thinking

definition_translations.zh_TW: 經常且規律做的事，有時不經思考
definition_translations.ja_JP: 頻繁かつ定期的に、時に無意識に行うこと
definition_translations.ko_KR: 자주 규칙적으로, 때로는 생각 없이 하는 일
definition_translations.vi_VN: việc bạn làm thường xuyên và đều đặn, đôi khi không suy nghĩ
definition_translations.th_TH: สิ่งที่ทำบ่อยและสม่ำเสมอ บางครั้งโดยไม่คิด

translations.th_TH: นิสัยทั่วไป
